Interface AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds

Enclosing class:
AlgoReplayAccounts
public static interface AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds
What a cash account can settle on a day, and what it can pass to another one. Both are answered by the caller rather than here, so the funds and the exchange rates are the ones the transaction write path checks against and the two cannot disagree about whether an order is payable.

  • Method Details

    • availableFor

      double availableFor(Integer idSecurityaccount, Cashaccount cashaccount, LocalDate date, String currency, double candidateAmount)
      Parameters:
      idSecurityaccount - the candidate broker account whose FX tariff applies
      cashaccount - the account in question
      date - the settlement day
      currency - the currency of the instrument, which the answer is expressed in so that the accounts of an environment are comparable with one another and with the price of the order
      candidateAmount - the order amount being priced in instrument currency
      Returns:
      what the account can spend that day, expressed in currency; Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY when it may be overdrawn and the question therefore has no limit, Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY when it cannot settle in that currency at all because the day has no exchange rate

    • transferable

      double transferable(Integer idSecurityaccount, Cashaccount from, Cashaccount to, LocalDate date, double candidateAmount)
      What one account could hand to another one on a day. The direction matters twice over: the transfer is booked with the rate of the pair from -> to, and only that direction of the pair may exist.
      Parameters:
      idSecurityaccount - the beneficiary broker account whose FX tariff applies
      from - the account the money would leave
      to - the account it would arrive on
      date - the day of the transfer
      candidateAmount - the wanted deposit in target currency
      Returns:
      the amount, expressed in the currency of to; Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY when the transfer cannot be priced that day and the two accounts are therefore not connectable
